note: A selection that holds the GOTO but not the N100 it points at. The block outside the selection keeps its number, so rewriting the jump would send it somewhere else; the value stays and the line is reported. P4d review NC-4: the selection writes N10, which line 2 above it carries as well, so the program has two N10 blocks now; the run warns and puts a row on both lines (it does not refuse).
